svg.aria-label: Response cycling in a Rift stub with responses A (repeat 2), B and C: each request is answered by the response at the head of the queue, which moves to the tail once it has been served repeat times, so requests get A, A, B, C, A. Replacing the stub by id keeps the cycle; replacing it at its index resets it to A. Captions list the other resets (PUT /imposters, DELETE savedProxyResponses) and what keeps the cycle (replace by id, a reload that leaves the stub unchanged).
svg.title: Response cycling in a Rift stub with responses A (repeat 2), B and C: each request is answered by the response at the head of the queue, which moves to the tail once it has been served repeat times, so requests get A, A, B, C, A. Replacing the stub by id keeps the cycle; replacing it at its index resets it to A. Captions list the other resets (PUT /imposters, DELETE savedProxyResponses) and what keeps the cycle (replace by id, a reload that leaves the stub unchanged).
svg.text: response cycle · a rotating queue per stub
RESETS THE CYCLE (back to the first response)
· PUT /imposters/:port/stubs/:index — replace at index, even unchanged #1515
· PUT /imposters — every imposter in the body, unless ?reconcile=true #1518
· deleting and recreating the imposter; replacing the whole stub list
· PUT /imposters/:port/stubs/by-id/:id — replace by id (a Rift extension)
· a reload that leaves the stub unchanged, e.g. PUT /imposters?reconcile=true
· inserting, deleting or replacing another stub; moving this one
each request takes the head; after `repeat` serves it rotates to the tail; replacing the stub at its index restarts it
